name: National Dex Gen 3
description: FireRed, LeafGreen, Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald: registers National Dex species #387-1025 (Gen 4-9) and 84 alternate forms as data -- stats, typing, Gen 3-expressible learnsets, abilities and evolutions, generated from PokéAPI. Evolutions that depend on the time of day, gender, held item, battle ground or recoil damage work too, on the device or in-game clock. Registers 30 evolution items Gen 3 lacks (with Bag icons and shops). Ships cries for every species. A framework, not an art pack: no species sprites or party icons ship; sprite mods plug in through setArtProvider.
